index.question: Can this shop help with my aircraft or symptom?
index.early: Aircraft class, ROTAX specialty and KAKH are visible before the primary CTA.
index.proof: Installed-engine hero; four distinct measurements/conditions under Work, documented.
index.mobile: Mobile stacks the hero after the CTA; desktop keeps image beside the introduction.
index.burden: Owner-path cards add choice, but none demands a diagnosis. Long detail below proof is divided by descriptive headings.
index.correction: Header derivatives and actual wordmark ratio remove shift without changing identity.

services.question: Which service should I ask about?
services.early: Plain-language maintenance, troubleshooting and buying paths.
services.proof: Four contextual images follow three short service groups.
services.mobile: Single-column mobile; desktop aside does not displace the main reading column.
services.burden: Broad service taxonomy is supported by contextual links rather than another grid of equal cards.
services.correction: Added direct records, prebuy, propeller and ROTAX paths.

e-props-dealer-support.question: How do fitment, ordering and support work?
e-props-dealer-support.early: Fitment and manufacturer-level boundaries precede detailed process.
e-props-dealer-support.proof: Redacted packet/checklist, installed propeller and blade detail.
e-props-dealer-support.mobile: Document previews contain their complete subjects; captions wrap without clipping.
e-props-dealer-support.burden: Longest technical page; headings break up ordering, configuration, records and support. A preview is not approval for another aircraft.
e-props-dealer-support.correction: Expanded signature mask after source-resolution review; retested page at six widths.

the-lima-charlie-aero-standard.question: What does the company method look like in practice?
the-lima-charlie-aero-standard.early: Institutional process and scope decisions, without founder-as-default CTA.
the-lima-charlie-aero-standard.proof: Crack, joint detail and photographed cage under Standard in practice.
the-lima-charlie-aero-standard.mobile: Three proof figures stack with their own captions; crack remains visible.
the-lima-charlie-aero-standard.burden: Captions deliberately do not assert structural acceptance or verified chronology. Owner records are still required for that stronger claim.
the-lima-charlie-aero-standard.correction: Retained factual limitations and sequence review gate.

rotax-9-series-912-914-915-916-support.question: Where should I start if I know only the engine family?
rotax-9-series-912-914-915-916-support.early: Family guide begins with uncertainty-friendly model context.
rotax-9-series-912-914-915-916-support.proof: Hoist/work context plus measurement kit after the family introduction.
rotax-9-series-912-914-915-916-support.mobile: Portrait images retain full aircraft/equipment context on mobile.
rotax-9-series-912-914-915-916-support.burden: Engine-family jargon is followed by problem categories and links; reader need not choose a component.
rotax-9-series-912-914-915-916-support.correction: Corrected earlier text-only hub with relevant existing proof.

rotax-engine-systems-support.question: Could the symptom involve systems around the engine?
rotax-engine-systems-support.early: Broad owner observation and installation context.
rotax-engine-systems-support.proof: Contextual system imagery and specific service links.
rotax-engine-systems-support.mobile: Six tested widths; separate mobile/desktop review captures supplied.
rotax-engine-systems-support.burden: Technical depth remains under system-specific headings.
rotax-engine-systems-support.correction: Contextual cross-links preserve the relationship between engine and surrounding systems.

rotax-gearbox-propeller-vibration.question: What does a vibration reading actually establish?
rotax-gearbox-propeller-vibration.early: Symptom and maintenance history before diagnosis.
rotax-gearbox-propeller-vibration.proof: 1.27 IPS display, component surfaces, separate 0.04 IPS display and equipment setup.
rotax-gearbox-propeller-vibration.mobile: Readings are uncropped; caption stays with its image at mobile width.
rotax-gearbox-propeller-vibration.burden: Six figures are a long module, justified by measurement and mechanical evidence; captions explicitly deny unsupported causal before/after inference.
rotax-gearbox-propeller-vibration.correction: No implied universal balancing result; current-instruction context retained.

rotax-installation-review.question: Could installation details explain this concern?
rotax-installation-review.early: Hoses, controls, wiring and access are named in the entry.
rotax-installation-review.proof: Engine access, crack, joint angles, photographed cage and workshop context.
rotax-installation-review.mobile: Portrait work images remain contained, without cropping joint geometry.
rotax-installation-review.burden: Several figures are deliberate evidence detail; facility image is expressly not an inspection report.
rotax-installation-review.correction: Cross-links connect fluid, fuel, electrical and records work.

rotax-fuel-pressure-fuel-delivery-proble.question: What information helps trace a pressure or delivery problem?
rotax-fuel-pressure-fuel-delivery-proble.early: Observed conditions and installation history precede parts replacement.
rotax-fuel-pressure-fuel-delivery-proble.proof: Two distinct tank views and pump/installation context.
rotax-fuel-pressure-fuel-delivery-proble.mobile: Borescope display edges remain visible; captions fit a single column.
rotax-fuel-pressure-fuel-delivery-proble.burden: The clean-looking view does not prove a cleaning chronology or identify the material.
rotax-fuel-pressure-fuel-delivery-proble.correction: Preserved factual limits and source-rights hold.

light-sport-prebuy-evaluation.question: What review should I request before buying?
light-sport-prebuy-evaluation.early: Listing link is enough to start; tail number optional.
light-sport-prebuy-evaluation.mobile: Comparison table fits 390px; full browser checks cover 320px.
light-sport-prebuy-evaluation.burden: Review depth and deliverables remain distinct; aircraft condition and paperwork are not collapsed into a guarantee.
light-sport-prebuy-evaluation.correction: Related records inquiry is directly linked.

light-sport-experimental-avionics.question: Can I start with a display or electrical symptom?
light-sport-experimental-avionics.early: Plain-language symptom/equipment goal before technical detail.
light-sport-experimental-avionics.proof: Installed panel plus connector, behind-panel and bench evidence.
light-sport-experimental-avionics.mobile: Small wiring/termination subjects remain visible with contain sizing.
light-sport-experimental-avionics.burden: Several photographs establish access and connection context; no expensive component failure is diagnosed from one photo.

aircraft-records-review.question: What will a records review tell me?
aircraft-records-review.early: Missing entries and inspection questions before travel/purchase.
aircraft-records-review.proof: Redacted logbook; captions explain the privacy limit.
aircraft-records-review.mobile: Record covers remain visible; illustrative findings table is readable and labeled.
aircraft-records-review.burden: Large privacy mask weakens detailed-record proof but protects identifiers; genuine cleared sample records require owner approval.
aircraft-records-review.correction: Retained useful findings/deliverable structure; no invented customer finding.

contact.question: How do I start a conversation with the business?
contact.early: Company contact, KAKH and no-diagnosis-needed invitation.
contact.mobile: Call/Text and Request Service remain separate touch targets.
contact.burden: Appointment and scope still require confirmation; no promised turnaround.

support-request.question: Can I ask for help without complete technical details?
support-request.early: Short introduction followed immediately by name/reply fields.
support-request.proof: No decorative proof competes with the intake task.
support-request.mobile: Single-column mobile; visible desktop primary CTA and alternative call option.
support-request.burden: Required name/contact/message distinguished from collapsed optional aircraft data.
support-request.correction: Active nav contrast corrected; mock failure/retry and phone-only/email-only paths tested.

service-area.question: Where is the shop and how do I arrange access?
service-area.early: KAKH/Gastonia, regional relevance and appointment basis.
service-area.proof: Aircraft/work access context, without invented mobile-service imagery.
service-area.mobile: Scope and coordination paragraphs precede the photo on mobile.
service-area.burden: Travel/location planning can be confused with service promises; explicit coordination language resolves that.
